page_title: Shuffle - A fast, native file manager for macOS

sources.entry: Shuffle - Fast, GPU-rendered file manager and Finder alternative built in Rust. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/WizenPainter/shuffle) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Shuffle
summary.one_liner: Shuffle is a free, open source, GPU-rendered file manager and Finder alternative for macOS, built in Rust.
keywords: cloud drives dropbox google drive onedrive icloud
use_cases: replace Finder with a faster file browser
browse and organize files side by side in two panes
quickly find files in the home directory by name
navigate folders from a shell-like command bar
preview images, PDFs and docs without opening apps
manage files across cloud drives and network servers
summary.what_it_does: Shuffle is a native macOS file manager with dual panes created by dragging a tab to the window edge, each pane with its own tabs, history, and filter. A command palette (⌘P) offers fuzzy search over the home directory with typo tolerance, live path browsing, and quick commands. An optional terminal mode lets you use cd and Tab autocompletion in the explorer. It also provides QuickLook previews on single-click, a side inspector, an in-place filter for the current folder, automatic detection of Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud, and dozens of color theme presets with live per-color customization.
notable: Built in Rust with GPUI (the GPU UI framework behind Zed) and Metal rendering
Dual panes/split canvas with draggable divider
Optional terminal command bar with cd and Tab autocompletion
Universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel, requires macOS 12+
caveats: A one-time paid purchase for extra features may be added someday; not available yet
Prebuilt Intel binaries are on the roadmap, so Intel users currently need to build from source
Signed and notarized releases are listed as future roadmap items
Batch rename, archive browsing, Finder tags, plugin API and localization are roadmap items, not current features
